description: wind_direction_horizon=auto -- closes out the full 8-value enum. Unlike the vertical axis (wind_direction), which masks the underlying stored value and always reports 0 while its own auto toggle is active, the horizontal axis's auto is echoed back faithfully in /status.
app_confirmed: App shows the horizontal louver in auto mode.
notes: CONFIRMED: all 8 wind_direction_horizon values now live-confirmed: front, spot, wide, to_left, to_right, nearby_left, nearby_right, auto.

Notably different from wind_direction (vertical)'s auto behavior: writing/reading 'auto' here round-trips honestly in /status, no masking of an underlying stored value the way vertical's numeric 0 does. Not yet tested whether horizontal auto has the same 'API can enter but not leave' asymmetry as vertical -- would need a follow-up write to a fixed position while horizontal auto is active to check.
